mapper.select: SELECT id,tenant_id,workflow_id,status,current_draft_revision,active_definition_version_id,created_at,updated_at FROM nw_workflow_containers WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND workflow_id=#{workflowId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_workflow_builder_snapshots SET draft_revision=#{nextRevision},updated_at=now() WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND container_id=#{containerId} AND draft_revision=#{expectedRevision}
